text: {"lessons":["I should not use my purchase price or whether a position is up or down as a reason to trade; average cost does not predict future returns.","I should evaluate every holding consistently, rather than selling winners for reassurance or keeping losers to avoid admitting a mistake.","Because prices move randomly, recent declines and frequent account checks are not reliable signals; I should make trades only for sound forward-looking reasons and avoid reacting to short-term losses."]}
